purpose: test whether any apparent EQIR gain is explained by ordinary multisource fusion and multibranch auxiliary supervision rather than evidence qualification, exact fallback or dual-query base-relative tail-risk control

why_not_use_the_released_mfdr_headline_a.execution: RunModel.py has a release-blocking syntax error and the loader requires unshipped BERT resources through three hard-coded absolute paths
why_not_use_the_released_mfdr_headline_a.split: the released code reuses one warm random fixed 20 percent test set for five inner-fold models, omits the final shuffled row and applies drop_last to train, validation and test
why_not_use_the_released_mfdr_headline_a.data: Enzyme contains 92 and GPCR contains 258 trainval-test opposite-label pair collisions; the Enzyme release has 5840 rows while the paper table states 5940
why_not_use_the_released_mfdr_headline_a.implementation: sequence-length-one attention is query-independent with zero WQ/WK gradients; DWLoss parameters are not included in the optimizer; descriptor scaling is fit on the complete dataset
why_not_use_the_released_mfdr_headline_a.conclusion: the control below is capacity-matched and MFDR-inspired, not an official reproduction and not a numerical comparison to the published headline

shared_protocol.inner_validation: the same deterministic grouped inner folds jointly respecting target homology cluster and drug scaffold group as EQIR
shared_protocol.fit_boundary: all projections, normalization statistics, auxiliary heads, fusion parameters and checkpoints are learned inside the current frozen TRAIN/VALID boundary; held TEST is evaluated once
shared_protocol.selection_objective: equal-weight mean of inner-validation micro AUPRC, target-macro AUPRC and drug-macro AUPRC
selection_constraints: drug-macro must not be below the frozen query-balanced base
target-macro may be at most 0.002 below the frozen query-balanced base
held TEST labels may not influence normalization, hyperparameters, checkpoint selection, calibration or modality weights

missingness: fixed all-zero structure vector plus explicit missingness bit when a(t)=0

required_variants.name: MFDR_INSPIRED_DIRECT_MULTIVIEW_FUSION
required_variants.role: ordinary direct multisource fusion control without auxiliary branch losses, exact fallback or base-relative risk constraints
required_variants.mechanism: separate LayerNorm plus low-rank projections for nonstructural and structure views; concatenate projected views, elementwise product, absolute difference, eligibility bit and base logit; classify with a two-layer SiLU MLP

required_variants.name: MFDR_INSPIRED_MULTIBRANCH_AUXILIARY_FUSION
required_variants.role: tests whether auxiliary supervision alone explains an EQIR gain
required_variants.mechanism: the direct multiview fusion control plus nonstructural-only, structure-only and fused prediction heads
required_variants.objective: fused BCE plus three auxiliary BCE terms whose coefficients are validation-selected from a frozen finite grid; all coefficient logits must be included in the optimizer when learnable

required_variants.name: EQIR_FULL
required_variants.role: preregistered qualified-structure candidate with exact fallback and dual-query base-relative tail-risk constraints

control_constraints.cross_attention: not used in the primary control because the official MFDR attention is mathematically degenerate at sequence length one; an optional corrected token-level attention diagnostic cannot replace the preregistered concat control
control_constraints.normalization: all normalization is fit using current TRAIN only
control_constraints.missing_structure: ordinary controls use a zero vector plus missingness bit and are allowed to change the base prediction when structure is absent; this deliberately tests the value of EQIR exact fallback

capacity_and_training_fairness.parameter_matching: choose the smallest control within plus or minus 10 percent of EQIR active trainable parameters; if no exact candidate exists, use the nearest model and report the mismatch
capacity_and_training_fairness.same_batches: use the same fold-specific pair population, eligibility mask and seed order as EQIR

mandatory_metrics_and_gates.minimum_support: at least 4 of 5 EQIR seeds improve versus each control, both cold-axis CI lower bounds exceed zero, target-macro is noninferior within -0.002, drug-macro grouped CI lower bound exceeds zero, and both query-direction permutation gates pass
